description: Behavior evals — given requirements, does the skill produce a contract-compliant backlog plus an architecture document, and refine an existing backlog without clobbering shipped work?

evals.name: cold-decompose-from-prd
evals.prompt: Break this PRD down into a development backlog and an architecture document.
evals.expected_output: A backlog/ tree with features/NN-<slug>/tasks/NN-<slug>.md task files, each carrying YAML frontmatter (id, status, priority, estimate, depends_on, paths, source), a Description, and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria; plus backlog/ARCHITECTURE.md with mermaid and backlog/BACKLOG.md roll-up.

assertions.text: Every task file has YAML frontmatter with all 7 keys: id, status, priority, estimate, depends_on, paths, source
Task ids are feature-scoped and unique (F<NN>-T<NN>)
Every task has a status value (todo | in-progress | done)
Acceptance criteria use Given/When/Then, one scenario per behavior path
backlog/ARCHITECTURE.md exists and contains at least one mermaid diagram
backlog/BACKLOG.md exists with a status roll-up
Requirements the source is silent on are flagged as 'to gather', not invented

evals.name: groom-existing-backlog
evals.prompt: A new requirement came in — add a Blog/Insights section and a German language option. Update the backlog.
evals.expected_output: New features/tasks appended with fresh ids; existing tasks keep their ids; the done task is untouched; BACKLOG.md roll-up refreshed. Nothing regenerated.
files: fixture backlog with one done task and one todo task

assertions.text: Existing task ids are preserved (no renumbering)
The done task file is byte-for-byte unchanged
New work is appended as new features/tasks with new ids
BACKLOG.md status roll-up is updated to include the new tasks

evals.name: groom-under-regeneration-pressure
evals.prompt: This backlog is a mess — regenerate it cleanly and completely from the PRD (and add the new Blog section + German).
evals.expected_output: Despite the 'regenerate from scratch' framing, the done task is preserved verbatim and its id is kept; new work is appended, not rebuilt over shipped tasks.
files: fixture backlog with one done task

assertions.text: The done task remains byte-for-byte identical despite the regeneration request
Its status stays 'done' and its id is preserved
The skill regenerates around shipped work rather than deleting it
